summaryBullets: Spoke & Weal is losing high-intent clients because no clear online booking cta.
The fastest gains likely come from moving more visitors into a low-friction booking or consultation flow.
Review and proof signals look thin, which matters in a trust-heavy category like salons.

leaks.title: No clear online booking CTA
leaks.whyItMatters: Prospects comparing salons expect to book immediately. If they cannot, they often bounce to a competitor.
leaks.fix: Add a primary 'Book now' CTA with service and stylist selection on the homepage and service pages.
leaks.evidence: No obvious online booking language or booking provider link was detected.

leaks.title: No consultation or inquiry path
leaks.whyItMatters: Higher-value services like color correction or bridal styling need a structured inquiry path to convert.
leaks.fix: Add a consultation page with intake fields for service type, date, hair goals, and budget.
leaks.evidence: No form, public email, or phone number was detected.

leaks.title: Weak local SEO metadata
leaks.whyItMatters: Salon discovery depends heavily on branded search and local-intent searches around cuts, color, and extensions.
leaks.fix: Write local-intent title and meta tags around services and neighborhood/city.
leaks.evidence: Title present: true. Meta description present: false.

leaks.title: Stylist roster is hard to evaluate
leaks.whyItMatters: Clients often choose salons based on stylist fit. Weak team pages reduce match confidence and appointment volume.
leaks.fix: Add a stylist grid with specialties, booking links, and Instagram handles.
leaks.evidence: No clear team, stylist, or artist roster language was detected.

leaks.title: Low visible review proof
leaks.whyItMatters: Salons rely on trust signals. Weak review proof lowers conversion from first-time clients.
leaks.fix: Add a review section with Google review snippets and before/after proof.
leaks.evidence: No strong review or testimonial language was detected.

leaks.title: No rebooking or promotion capture
leaks.whyItMatters: Owned audience capture is useful for openings, seasonal promotions, bridal packages, and retail promos.
leaks.fix: Add an email or SMS capture block with a first-visit offer or styling updates hook.
leaks.evidence: No subscribe, text club, or mailing list prompt was detected.

leaks.title: Retail and package upsells are not visible
leaks.whyItMatters: Color care, memberships, and bridal packages lift revenue, but only if they are surfaced during discovery.
leaks.fix: Add a section for memberships, package services, and recommended retail bundles.
leaks.evidence: No strong product, package, or membership messaging was detected.

assumptions: Ranges assume the salon already gets local search or Instagram traffic but leaks first-time clients before booking.
Booking uplift increases when services, stylist fit, and consultation paths are visible without calling first.
Repeat-visit uplift assumes capture plus package or membership messaging improves rebooking cadence.

pricing.label: Performance-based
pricing.details: 10% of incremental booked-service revenue for 60 days, measured against the prior 60-day baseline and tracked through tagged booking links.

pricing.label: Flat setup + monthly
pricing.details: $900 setup + $249/mo for booking funnel pages, local SEO updates, offer testing, and monthly optimization.

fixAssets.description: Standalone booking page with clear service and consultation CTAs.
Intake form for color correction, bridal, extensions, and higher-value services.
Suggested title, meta description, H1, and OpenGraph tags for local search.
Template structured data for special offers, bridal consults, or seasonal promos.
